figures.Question: Which parts are inside Aster and what crosses its boundary?
figures.Companions: The external interface table and component-composition example.

boundary.content:
AsterHub is the only element inside the product boundary. Operator and WeatherService are external actors; the figure shows exchange direction without implying internal decomposition.

fields.system_boundary: AsterHub owns sampling and buffering; Operator and WeatherService, probe power supply, and irrigation decisions are outside.
fields.external_actors: Operator requests current readings and sends calibration commands; WeatherService supplies forecast data used only for display context.
fields.diagram_decisions: [{"concern":"system-boundary","applies":true,"choice":"figure","rationale":"A boundary view makes inside/outside ownership and exchange direction unambiguous.","asset":"assets/system-context.svg","model_view":"Example::SystemContext"}]

interfaces.content: Validated readings leave AsterHub for Operator, calibration commands enter from Operator, and forecast records arrive from WeatherService without being stored as sensor measurements.

fields.information_flows: Outgoing Reading and HistoryResponse, incoming CalibrationCommand, and incoming ForecastRecord have distinct meanings and owners.
fields.interface_participants: AsterHub is provider for readings and receiver for calibration; Operator consumes readings; WeatherService is a read-only forecast source.

behavior.content: AsterHub continues sampling when Operator disconnects and labels forecast data as external context rather than using it to alter readings.

fields.interactions: Operator queries and calibrates, WeatherService publishes forecasts, and AsterHub samples and responds independently of forecast availability.
fields.states: Online, operator-disconnected, and forecast-unavailable states clarify which external losses do and do not affect collection.

constraints.content: No external actor may rewrite buffered history, and calibration commands never change the meaning of the Reading timestamp or measured value.

fields.constraints: History is read-only externally, forecast data is informational, and calibration applies only to subsequent samples.
fields.design_rationale: These boundaries prevent external systems from silently corrupting measurement provenance or becoming hidden sampling dependencies.

trace.content: Example::SystemContext names the fictional view behind the figure; the component-composition and operation-contract examples own internal and protocol details.

fields.model_elements: Example::SystemContext, Example::Sensor, Example::Controller, and Example::WeatherService define the context participants and view.
fields.verification_links: A planned context review checks boundary placement, actor coverage, exchange direction, and the absence of internal-only details.
